about: One-sentence requests a person might give a fresh Claude Code or Codex session. expect: build (loot covers it: a checked xsolana.json, no contract code), partial (loot covers the core; the session should say what it can't do), refuse (a defining piece is missing: the session says so and writes no contract). parts: what a good spec uses. flags: warnings a good answer passes on.

prompts.prompt: Make me a coin flip game on Solana: 0.1 SOL a flip, double or nothing, with a small house edge.
I want a gacha for my game with five rarities and a pity system so nobody goes more than 90 pulls without a legendary.
Let holders stake their miner NFTs to earn our MINE token, and higher-level miners should earn more.
Run a weekly raffle where tickets cost 0.01 SOL and three winners split the pot 50/30/20.
Players should be able to merge three common swords into one rare sword, and three rares into an epic.
Sell 100 founder badges for 0.5 SOL each, soulbound, and 10% of each sale goes to a community pool.
A drop where the price starts at 2 SOL and falls every 10 minutes until someone buys, never below 0.2 SOL.
Mint 10,000 game tokens a day into a rewards pool, halving every 30 days, and let players claim daily with a season pass.
Players who finish a quest in my game should get a reward NFT, one per person, signed off by my server.
Airdrop 50 of our points token to these early supporters, once each, no matter what wallet they use later.
Only players holding a level 10 or higher badge can open the dragon chest, and their luck stat should improve the odds.
Let people bring their Mad Lads into my game as playable characters without selling them.
Make a pool where fans bet on which team wins the final, with a 5% rake for the house.
Sell card packs for 1 USDC; 20% of every pack funds a monthly tournament prize pool.
Horses can breed once a week for a fee; the foal is ready after 7 days, and each mare can have 6 foals in her life.
An entry fee of 0.05 SOL per run, with 10% to whoever referred the player and the rest to the prize pool.
Players send their ships on 6-hour missions; my server decides whether they come back with loot or get destroyed.
Burn 1% of the treasury pool every day so the token gets scarcer over time.
Feeding three potions to a pet should raise its level by one, right on the NFT.
Every tip to my stream should be split between me and my six collaborators equally.
Convert each player's season points into tokens: some get 10, some get 500, from one list.
A monthly VIP membership that charges members automatically every month.
Holders of our token who stake it should get 30% of all game revenue.
Run an English auction for my 1-of-1 sword: highest bid after 24 hours wins, outbid players get refunded.
Run a sealed-bid auction for my rare sword: nobody sees the bids until it ends, then the highest bid wins.
Build a perpetual futures exchange for our token with 10x leverage.
Let players borrow SOL against their NFTs, with liquidation if the floor drops.
Launch our game token on a bonding curve that pays me 1% of every trade.
Make an automated market maker pool so players can swap gold for gems.
For my Discord: a free welcome badge, a shop for merch NFTs, and staking the badge earns a weekly points drip.
Design the whole economy for a dungeon crawler: loot chests, crafting gear from drops, and staking rare gear to earn the game's gold.
